model.executionRule: Aqua capacity survives when aggregate sibling demand <= realInventory - q
model.firmAdmissionRule: q <= realInventory and q <= bondPool * (1 - bondUtilization)
model.hardReservationRule: q is removed from sibling-available inventory for the full TTL
model.limitation: Synthetic stress model; results are not observed Aqua failure rates or actuarial claims
